title: StreamFi
tagline: From stranger to friend, from creativity to crypto, the magic awaits you!
description:
It's a cross-chain gamified streaming platform. By 'gaming,' I mean a platform that promotes more human-to-human interaction, including the use of AR and VR in combination with OpenAI's vision model for interactive games in future releases. The goal is to bridge the gap between crypto and the common user, facilitating the onboarding of potentially the next million crypto users worldwide. The aim is to spread crypto usage in a way that is easily understandable for the general public, rather than focusing on how we built it. The platform ensures that its users are always in the front row, and primarily, it will be a mobile application to facilitate mass adoption.
